narrative.northStar: Hành trình pixel mang theo mình
narrative.overview: Preserve the inherited dark pixel-game art and use self-hosted Be Vietnam Pro for Vietnamese text throughout the game, intro and offline utility. The Latin brand logo retains Jersey 15. Utility sizes remain unchanged; browser QA of the font repair is in progress and does not establish physical-device validation.
keyCharacteristics: Inherited pixel art and dark game panels
Self-hosted Be Vietnam Pro for Vietnamese game and utility text

rules.name: The Action Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: One full-width yellow download action; save transfer remains a balanced secondary pair.

rules.name: The Vietnamese Coverage Rule
rules.body: Use shared self-hosted Be Vietnam Pro for Vietnamese interface and canvas text; retain Jersey 15 only for the Latin brand logo. Preserve the separate game and utility type scales.

dos: Do preserve game art and attribution.
Do preserve visible focus and touch-friendly controls.
donts: Don't replace the game with dashboard styling.
Don't claim physical-device validation from browser screenshots.
Don't imply functional cloud or multiplayer features.
